7	class TeamPlanner(JsonStore):
8	    def add_member(self, member_id, name):
9	        member_id, name = text(member_id, "member_id"), text(name, "name")
10	        data = self._read()
11	        members = data.setdefault("members", {})
12	        if member_id in members:
13	            raise ValueError("member already exists")
14	        members[member_id] = {"member_id": member_id, "name": name}
15	        self._write(data)
16	        return members[member_id]
17	
18	    def create_activity(self, activity_id, title, on, capacity):
19	        activity_id, title = text(activity_id, "activity_id"), text(title, "title")
20	        on, capacity = date.fromisoformat(on).isoformat(), positive(capacity, "capacity")
21	        data = self._read()
22	        activities = data.setdefault("activities", {})
23	        if activity_id in activities:
24	            raise ValueError("activity already exists")
25	        activity = {"activity_id": activity_id, "title": title, "on": on, "capacity": capacity, "participants": []}
26	        activities[activity_id] = activity
27	        self._write(data)
28	        return activity
29	
30	    def enroll(self, activity_id, member_id):
31	        data = self._read()
32	        activity = data.get("activities", {}).get(activity_id)
33	        if activity is None or member_id not in data.get("members", {}):
34	            raise ValueError("unknown activity or member")
35	        if member_id in activity["participants"]:
36	            raise ValueError("member already enrolled")
37	        if len(activity["participants"]) >= activity["capacity"]:
38	            raise ValueError("activity is full")
39	        activity["participants"].append(member_id)
40	        self._write(data)
41	        return activity
42	
43	    def enroll_batch(self, records):
44	        # The whole group takes effect at once: every entry is normalized and
45	        # checked before any participant list is touched.
46	        if not isinstance(records, list) or not records:
47	            raise ValueError("records must be a nonempty array")
48	        entries = []
49	        seen = set()
50	        for item in records:
51	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"activity_id", "member_id"}:
52	                raise ValueError("each record must contain only activity_id and member_id")
53	            activity_id = text(item["activity_id"], "activity_id")
54	            member_id = text(item["member_id"], "member_id")
55	            # A repeated activity/member pair rejects the whole group; one
56	            # member may still join several activities and one activity may
57	            # still receive several members.
58	            pair = (activity_id, member_id)
59	            if pair in seen:
60	                raise ValueError("records must not contain duplicate activity and member pairs")
61	            seen.add(pair)
62	            entries.append((activity_id, member_id))
63	        data = self._read()
64	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
65	        members = data.get("members", {})
66	        for activity_id, member_id in entries:
67	            activity = activities.get(activity_id)
68	            if activity is None or member_id not in members:
69	                raise ValueError("unknown activity or member")
70	            if member_id in activity["participants"]:
71	                raise ValueError("member already enrolled")
72	        # Capacity is judged on the final rosters: the original list plus
73	        # every new enrollment of this group. Completed enrollments keep
74	        # their seats, so the participants lists already cover them.
75	        delta = {}
76	        for activity_id, _ in entries:
77	            delta[activity_id] = delta.get(activity_id, 0) + 1
78	        for activity_id, change in delta.items():
79	            activity = activities[activity_id]
80	            if len(activity["participants"]) + change > activity["capacity"]:
81	                raise ValueError("activity is full")
82	        # Same-day conflicts are judged on the final enrollments too: a new
83	        # enrollment must not collide with the member's existing enrollments
84	        # on that date (completed ones still count) nor with another entry of
85	        # this group. Other members' enrollments and historical conflicts on
86	        # dates the member is not newly joining never block the group.
87	        joining = {}
88	        for activity_id, member_id in entries:
89	            joining.setdefault(member_id, {}).setdefault(activities[activity_id]["on"], set()).add(activity_id)
90	        for activity_id, member_id in entries:
91	            on = activities[activity_id]["on"]
92	            if len(joining[member_id][on]) > 1:
93	                raise ValueError("member is enrolled in another activity on that date")
94	            for other_id, other in activities.items():
95	                if other_id != activity_id and other.get("on") == on and member_id in other.get("participants", []):
96	                    raise ValueError("member is enrolled in another activity on that date")
97	        # New members are appended to each roster in input order; everyone
98	        # already enrolled keeps their relative position.
99	        for activity_id, member_id in entries:
100	            activities[activity_id]["participants"].append(member_id)
101	        self._write(data)
102	        # One full activity object per entry, in input order; an activity
103	        # named by several entries reflects the final roster after the group.
104	        return [activities[activity_id] for activity_id, _ in entries]
105	
106	    def preview_enrollments(self, records):
107	        # Read-only preview of enroll_batch: the same normalization and
108	        # validation, but nothing is ever written back and no missing
109	        # directory or file is created.
110	        if not isinstance(records, list) or not records:
111	            raise ValueError("records must be a nonempty array")
112	        entries = []
113	        seen = set()
114	        for item in records:
115	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"activity_id", "member_id"}:
116	                raise ValueError("each record must contain only activity_id and member_id")
117	            activity_id = text(item["activity_id"], "activity_id")
118	            member_id = text(item["member_id"], "member_id")
119	            # A repeated activity/member pair rejects the preview, exactly as
120	            # it rejects the mutating batch.
121	            pair = (activity_id, member_id)
122	            if pair in seen:
123	                raise ValueError("records must not contain duplicate activity and member pairs")
124	            seen.add(pair)
125	            entries.append((activity_id, member_id))
126	        data = self._read()
127	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
128	        members = data.get("members", {})
129	        # Structural errors reject the preview outright, exactly as in the
130	        # mutating batch: unknown activity or member, or a member already
131	        # enrolled in the named activity.
132	        for activity_id, member_id in entries:
133	            activity = activities.get(activity_id)
134	            if activity is None or member_id not in members:
135	                raise ValueError("unknown activity or member")
136	            if member_id in activity["participants"]:
137	                raise ValueError("member already enrolled")
138	        # Remaining seats are judged on the final rosters: capacity minus the
139	        # original list minus every new enrollment of this group. Entries for
140	        # the same activity share one count, an overbooked activity keeps its
141	        # negative count, and completed enrollments still occupy their seats.
142	        delta = {}
143	        for activity_id, _ in entries:
144	            delta[activity_id] = delta.get(activity_id, 0) + 1
145	        remaining = {
146	            activity_id: activities[activity_id]["capacity"] - (len(activities[activity_id].get("participants", [])) + change)
147	            for activity_id, change in delta.items()
148	        }
149	        # Conflicts are judged on the final enrollments too: the member's
150	        # current enrollments on the target date plus the other entries of
151	        # this group on that date, excluding the entry's own target.
152	        # Completed enrollments still count; other members' enrollments and
153	        # other dates never do.
154	        joining = {}
155	        for activity_id, member_id in entries:
156	            joining.setdefault(member_id, {}).setdefault(activities[activity_id]["on"], set()).add(activity_id)
157	        preview = []
158	        for activity_id, member_id in entries:
159	            on = activities[activity_id]["on"]
160	            conflicts = set(joining[member_id][on])
161	            for other_id, other in activities.items():
162	                if other.get("on") == on and member_id in other.get("participants", []):
163	                    conflicts.add(other_id)
164	            conflicts.discard(activity_id)
165	            preview.append({
166	                "activity_id": activity_id,
167	                "member_id": member_id,
168	                "remaining_seats": remaining[activity_id],
169	                "conflict_activity_ids": sorted(conflicts),
170	            })
171	        # Both kinds of obstacles are reported together; only a group where
172	        # every entry leaves a nonnegative seat count and no same-day
173	        # conflict can be enrolled.
174	        can_enroll = all(item["remaining_seats"] >= 0 and not item["conflict_activity_ids"] for item in preview)
175	        return {"can_enroll": can_enroll, "records": preview}
176	
177	    def transfer_enrollment(self, source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id):
178	        source_activity_id = text(source_activity_id, "source_activity_id")
179	        target_activity_id = text(target_activity_id, "target_activity_id")
180	        member_id = text(member_id, "member_id")
181	        data = self._read()
182	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
183	        source = activities.get(source_activity_id)
184	        target = activities.get(target_activity_id)
185	        if source is None or target is None or member_id not in data.get("members", {}):
186	            raise ValueError("unknown activity or member")
187	        if source_activity_id == target_activity_id:
188	            raise ValueError("source and target activities must differ")
189	        if member_id not in source["participants"]:
190	            raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the source activity")
191	        if member_id in target["participants"]:
192	            raise ValueError("member is already enrolled in the target activity")
193	        if len(target["participants"]) >= target["capacity"]:
194	            raise ValueError("target activity is full")
195	        # A finished training can neither be moved nor have its completion
196	        # record left behind; other members' records do not block the transfer.
197	        if member_id in data.get("completions", {}).get(source_activity_id, {}):
198	            raise ValueError("member has a completion record for the source activity")
199	        # The member must not keep a seat in a third activity on the target
200	        # date. Completion does not cancel enrollment, so participants lists
201	        # already cover finished trainings; source and target are excluded.
202	        for other_id, other in activities.items():
203	            if other_id in (source_activity_id, target_activity_id):
204	                continue
205	            if other.get("on") == target["on"] and member_id in other.get("participants", []):
206	                raise ValueError("member is enrolled in another activity on the target date")
207	        source["participants"].remove(member_id)
208	        target["participants"].append(member_id)
209	        self._write(data)
210	        return target
211	
212	    def transfer_enrollments(self, changes):
213	        # The whole group takes effect at once: every change is normalized and
214	        # checked before any participant list is touched.
215	        if not isinstance(changes, list) or not changes:
216	            raise ValueError("changes must be a nonempty array")
217	        entries = []
218	        seen = set()
219	        for item in changes:
220	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"source_activity_id", "target_activity_id", "member_id"}:
221	                raise ValueError("each change must contain only source_activity_id, target_activity_id and member_id")
222	            source_activity_id = text(item["source_activity_id"], "source_activity_id")
223	            target_activity_id = text(item["target_activity_id"], "target_activity_id")
224	            member_id = text(item["member_id"], "member_id")
225	            # One member may move only once per group, so no entry can undo or
226	            # chain another entry's move.
227	            if member_id in seen:

233	        members = data.get("members", {})
234	        completions = data.get("completions", {})
235	        for source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id in entries:
236	            source = activities.get(source_activity_id)
237	            target = activities.get(target_activity_id)
238	            if source is None or target is None or member_id not in members:
239	                raise ValueError("unknown activity or member")
240	            if source_activity_id == target_activity_id:
241	                raise ValueError("source and target activities must differ")
242	            if member_id not in source["participants"]:
243	                raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the source activity")
244	            if member_id in target["participants"]:

289	            raise ValueError("changes must be a nonempty array")

291	        seen = set()
292	        for item in changes:
293	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"source_activity_id", "target_activity_id", "member_id"}:
294	                raise ValueError("each change must contain only source_activity_id, target_activity_id and member_id")
295	            source_activity_id = text(item["source_activity_id"], "source_activity_id")
296	            target_activity_id = text(item["target_activity_id"], "target_activity_id")
297	            member_id = text(item["member_id"], "member_id")
298	            # One member may move only once per group, so no entry can undo or
299	            # chain another entry's move.
300	            if member_id in seen:
301	                raise ValueError("changes must not contain duplicate member ids")
302	            seen.add(member_id)
303	            entries.append((source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id))
304	        data = self._read()
305	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
306	        members = data.get("members", {})
307	        completions = data.get("completions", {})
308	        # Structural errors reject the preview outright, exactly as in the
309	        # mutating batch: unknown activity or member, identical activities, a
310	        # missing source enrollment or an existing target enrollment.
311	        for source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id in entries:
312	            source = activities.get(source_activity_id)
313	            target = activities.get(target_activity_id)
314	            if source is None or target is None or member_id not in members:
315	                raise ValueError("unknown activity or member")
316	            if source_activity_id == target_activity_id:
317	                raise ValueError("source and target activities must differ")
318	            if member_id not in source["participants"]:
319	                raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the source activity")
320	            if member_id in target["participants"]:
321	                raise ValueError("member is already enrolled in the target activity")
322	        # Remaining seats are judged on the final rosters after the whole group
323	        # moves, so a swap or rotation between full activities leaves every
324	        # named target with a nonnegative count. Entries carrying a completion
325	        # record still count toward the group headcount.
326	        delta = {}
327	        for source_activity_id, target_activity_id, _ in entries:
328	            delta[source_activity_id] = delta.get(source_activity_id, 0) - 1
329	            delta[target_activity_id] = delta.get(target_activity_id, 0) + 1
330	        remaining = {
331	            activity_id: activities[activity_id]["capacity"] - (len(activities[activity_id].get("participants", [])) + change)
332	            for activity_id, change in delta.items()
333	        }
334	        preview = []
335	        for source_activity_id, target_activity_id, member_id in entries:
336	            # Only the member's own completion record for the source activity is
337	            # reported; other members' records never are. A missing completions
338	            # collection means no records at all.
339	            has_completion = member_id in completions.get(source_activity_id, {})
340	            # Conflicts use the final enrollments too: the member only leaves
341	            # the source and joins the target, both of which are excluded, so a
342	            # seat kept in a third activity on the target date is an obstacle.
343	            # Completed enrollments still count; other members' enrollments and
344	            # unrelated historical conflicts never do.
345	            target_on = activities[target_activity_id]["on"]
346	            excluded = {source_activity_id, target_activity_id}
347	            conflict_activity_ids = sorted(
348	                other_id
349	                for other_id, other in activities.items()
350	                if other_id not in excluded
351	                and other.get("on") == target_on
352	                and member_id in other.get("participants", [])
353	            )
354	            preview.append({
355	                "source_activity_id": source_activity_id,
356	                "target_activity_id": target_activity_id,
357	                "member_id": member_id,
358	                "has_completion": has_completion,
359	                "remaining_seats": remaining[target_activity_id],

363	        # every entry is free of a completion record, free of same-day conflicts

366	            not item["has_completion"] and not item["conflict_activity_ids"] and item["remaining_seats"] >= 0
367	            for item in preview

369	        return {"can_transfer": can_transfer, "changes": preview}

371	    def split_activity(self, source_activity_id, activity_id, title, on, capacity, member_ids):
372	        # The new session and the enrollment move take effect together: every
373	        # value is normalized and checked before the source roster is touched
374	        # or the new activity is created.
375	        source_activity_id = text(source_activity_id, "source_activity_id")
376	        activity_id, title = text(activity_id, "activity_id"), text(title, "title")
377	        on, capacity = day(on, "on"), positive(capacity, "capacity")
378	        if not isinstance(member_ids, list) or not member_ids:
379	            raise ValueError("member_ids must be a nonempty array")
380	        selected = []
381	        seen = set()
382	        for member_id in member_ids:
383	            member_id = text(member_id, "member_id")
384	            if member_id in seen:
385	                raise ValueError("member_ids must not contain duplicates")
386	            seen.add(member_id)
387	            selected.append(member_id)
388	        # The new session must seat everyone moved into it.
389	        if capacity < len(selected):
390	            raise ValueError("capacity must be at least the number of moved members")
391	        data = self._read()
392	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
393	        members = data.get("members", {})
394	        source = activities.get(source_activity_id)
395	        if source is None:
396	            raise ValueError("unknown activity")
397	        if activity_id in activities:
398	            raise ValueError("activity already exists")
399	        completions = data.get("completions", {})
400	        for member_id in selected:
401	            if member_id not in members:
402	                raise ValueError("unknown member")
403	            if member_id not in source["participants"]:
404	                raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the source activity")
405	            # Only the member's own completion record for the source activity
406	            # blocks the move; other members' records never do, and no record
407	            # is ever deleted or migrated.
408	            if member_id in completions.get(source_activity_id, {}):
409	                raise ValueError("member has a completion record for the source activity")
410	        # A moved member must not keep a seat in a third activity on the new
411	        # date. Completion does not cancel enrollment, so participants lists
412	        # already cover finished trainings; the source is excluded and other
413	        # members' enrollments or other dates never block the split.
414	        for member_id in selected:
415	            for other_id, other in activities.items():
416	                if other_id == source_activity_id:
417	                    continue
418	                if other.get("on") == on and member_id in other.get("participants", []):
419	                    raise ValueError("member is enrolled in another activity on that date")
420	        # Members who stay keep their relative order; the new roster follows
421	        # the input order exactly. The source keeps all its other fields and
422	        # stays in the file even when its roster becomes empty.
423	        moving = set(selected)
424	        source["participants"] = [member_id for member_id in source["participants"] if member_id not in moving]
425	        activity = {"activity_id": activity_id, "title": title, "on": on, "capacity": capacity, "participants": list(selected)}
426	        activities[activity_id] = activity
427	        self._write(data)
428	        return {"source_activity": source, "new_activity": activity}

643	    def record_completions(self, records):
644	        # The whole group takes effect at once: every entry is normalized and
645	        # checked before any record is written.
646	        if not isinstance(records, list) or not records:
647	            raise ValueError("records must be a nonempty array")
648	        entries = []
649	        seen = set()
650	        for item in records:
651	            if not isinstance(item, dict) or set(item) != {"activity_id", "member_id", "completed_on"}:
652	                raise ValueError("each record must contain only activity_id, member_id and completed_on")
653	            activity_id = text(item["activity_id"], "activity_id")
654	            member_id = text(item["member_id"], "member_id")
655	            completed_on = day(item["completed_on"], "completed_on")
656	            # A repeated activity/member pair rejects the whole group even when
657	            # both entries carry the same completion date; records are never
658	            # merged. Cross-activity and cross-member entries are allowed.
659	            pair = (activity_id, member_id)
660	            if pair in seen:
661	                raise ValueError("records must not contain duplicate activity and member pairs")
662	            seen.add(pair)
663	            entries.append((activity_id, member_id, completed_on))
664	        data = self._read()
665	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
666	        members = data.get("members", {})
667	        done = data.setdefault("completions", {})
668	        # Validate every entry first: the activity and member must exist, the
669	        # member must be enrolled, the completion date must not precede the
670	        # activity date, and neither the stored history nor an earlier entry in
671	        # this group may already hold the member's own record. Other members'
672	        # records never block the entry.
673	        for activity_id, member_id, completed_on in entries:
674	            activity = activities.get(activity_id)
675	            if activity is None:
676	                raise ValueError("unknown activity")
677	            if member_id not in members:
678	                raise ValueError("unknown member")
679	            if member_id not in activity.get("participants", []):
680	                raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the activity")
681	            if member_id in done.get(activity_id, {}):
682	                raise ValueError("completion already recorded")
683	            if date.fromisoformat(completed_on) < date.fromisoformat(activity["on"]):
684	                raise ValueError("completed_on must be on or after the activity date")
685	        # Only the selected records are added, in input order; enrollments keep
686	        # occupying capacity and participant order, profiles and activity fields
687	        # (including extra fields) are left untouched.
688	        result = []
689	        for activity_id, member_id, completed_on in entries:
690	            done.setdefault(activity_id, {})[member_id] = completed_on
691	            activity = activities[activity_id]
692	            result.append({"activity_id": activity_id, "member_id": member_id, "completed_on": completed_on, "title": activity["title"], "on": activity["on"]})
693	        self._write(data)

719	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
720	        members = data.get("members", {})
721	        done = data.get("completions", {})
722	        # Validate every entry first: the activity and member must exist, the
723	        # member must stay enrolled, and the member's own record must already
724	        # exist so it can be corrected. A new date must not precede the
725	        # activity date; revocation (null) carries no date check.
726	        previous = []
727	        for activity_id, member_id, completed_on in entries:
728	            activity = activities.get(activity_id)
729	            if activity is None:
730	                raise ValueError("unknown activity")
731	            if member_id not in members:
732	                raise ValueError("unknown member")
733	            if member_id not in activity.get("participants", []):
734	                raise ValueError("member is not enrolled in the activity")
735	            record = done.get(activity_id, {}).get(member_id)

742	        # null deletes just that member's record. Enrollments keep occupying
743	        # capacity and participant order; profiles, activity fields (including
744	        # extra fields) and other members' records are left untouched.
745	        changed = False
746	        result = []
747	        for (activity_id, member_id, completed_on), old in zip(entries, previous):
748	            activity = activities[activity_id]
749	            records_for_activity = done[activity_id]
750	            if completed_on is None:
751	                del records_for_activity[member_id]
752	            else:
753	                records_for_activity[member_id] = completed_on
754	            if completed_on != old:
755	                changed = True
756	            result.append({"activity_id": activity_id, "member_id": member_id, "title": activity["title"], "on": activity["on"], "previous_completed_on": old, "completed_on": completed_on})

758	        # leaves the file untouched, like a same-date reschedule.
759	        if changed:

778	    def merge_member(self, source_member_id, target_member_id):
779	        source = text(source_member_id, "source_member_id")
780	        target = text(target_member_id, "target_member_id")
781	        if source == target:
782	            raise ValueError("source and target must be different members")
783	        data = self._read()
784	        members = data.get("members", {})
785	        if source not in members or target not in members:
786	            raise ValueError("unknown member")
787	        completions = data.get("completions", {})
788	        # Validate every activity first: conflicting completion dates reject
789	        # the whole merge before any participant list is touched.
790	        for done in completions.values():
791	            if source in done and target in done and done[source] != done[target]:
792	                raise ValueError("completion dates differ for the two members")
793	        for activity in data.get("activities", {}).values():
794	            participants = activity.setdefault("participants", [])
795	            if source not in participants:
796	                continue
797	            source_index = participants.index(source)
798	            if target in participants:
799	                target_index = participants.index(target)
800	                # One retained seat at the earlier of the two positions;
801	                # everyone else keeps their relative order.
802	                keep_index, drop_index = (source_index, target_index) if source_index < target_index else (target_index, source_index)
803	                participants[keep_index] = target
804	                del participants[drop_index]
805	            else:
806	                participants[source_index] = target
807	        for activity_id, done in completions.items():
808	            if source not in done:
809	                continue
810	            merged = {}
811	            for member_id, completed_on in done.items():
812	                if member_id == source:
813	                    if target not in done:
814	                        merged[target] = completed_on
815	                else:
816	                    merged[member_id] = completed_on
817	            completions[activity_id] = merged
818	        del members[source]
819	        self._write(data)
820	        return members[target]

822	    def merge_activities(self, target_activity_id, source_activity_ids):
823	        # The whole merge takes effect at once: every identifier is normalized
824	        # and every rule is checked before any roster or completion record is
825	        # touched.
826	        target_activity_id = text(target_activity_id, "target_activity_id")
827	        if not isinstance(source_activity_ids, list) or not source_activity_ids:
828	            raise ValueError("source_activity_ids must be a nonempty array")
829	        source_ids = []
830	        seen = set()
831	        for activity_id in source_activity_ids:
832	            activity_id = text(activity_id, "source_activity_id")
833	            if activity_id in seen:
834	                raise ValueError("source_activity_ids must not contain duplicates")
835	            seen.add(activity_id)
836	            source_ids.append(activity_id)
837	        if target_activity_id in seen:
838	            raise ValueError("target_activity_id must not appear in source_activity_ids")
839	        data = self._read()
840	        activities = data.get("activities", {})
841	        target = activities.get(target_activity_id)
842	        if target is None or any(activities.get(activity_id) is None for activity_id in source_ids):
843	            raise ValueError("unknown activity")
844	        target_on = target["on"]
845	        # Titles may differ; every source must run on the target's date.
846	        for activity_id in source_ids:
847	            if activities[activity_id]["on"] != target_on:
848	                raise ValueError("every source activity must be on the target activity date")
849	        # The target roster keeps its original order; members not already in it
850	        # are appended by source input order and each source's own roster
851	        # order, one seat per member even when the same member sits in several
852	        # sources. Empty source rosters add nobody and are still merged away.
853	        merged_participants = list(target.get("participants", []))
854	        enrolled = set(merged_participants)
855	        transferring = []
856	        for activity_id in source_ids:
857	            for member_id in activities[activity_id].get("participants", []):
858	                if member_id in enrolled:
859	                    continue
860	                enrolled.add(member_id)
861	                merged_participants.append(member_id)
862	                transferring.append(member_id)
863	        if len(merged_participants) > target["capacity"]:
864	            raise ValueError("target activity is full")
865	        # Only members newly joining the target are checked for same-day
866	        # conflicts, and only after every source is gone: the sources are
867	        # excluded together with the target, so a seat kept in a third
868	        # activity on the same date rejects the merge. Completed enrollments
869	        # still count; the target's original members keep their historical
870	        # conflicts, and other members or other dates never block the merge.
871	        excluded = {target_activity_id, *source_ids}
872	        for member_id in transferring:
873	            for other_id, other in activities.items():
874	                if other_id in excluded:
875	                    continue
876	                if other.get("on") == target_on and member_id in other.get("participants", []):
877	                    raise ValueError("member is enrolled in another activity on that date")
878	        # Completion records flow into the target. One existing record keeps
879	        # its date; records in several places merge only when the dates agree
880	        # - differing dates reject the whole merge without picking or
881	        # rewriting a date. Members without a record stay pending.
882	        completions = data.get("completions", {})
883	        merged_done = dict(completions.get(target_activity_id, {}))
884	        for activity_id in source_ids:
885	            for member_id, completed_on in completions.get(activity_id, {}).items():
886	                if member_id in merged_done and merged_done[member_id] != completed_on:
887	                    raise ValueError("completion dates differ for the merged activities")
888	                merged_done.setdefault(member_id, completed_on)
889	        # All checks passed: rebuild the target roster (keeping its id, title,
890	        # date, capacity and extra fields) and delete the sources together
891	        # with the completion entries keyed to them.
892	        target["participants"] = merged_participants
893	        for activity_id in source_ids:
894	            del activities[activity_id]
895	        if target_activity_id in completions or merged_done:
896	            completions[target_activity_id] = merged_done
897	        for activity_id in source_ids:
898	            completions.pop(activity_id, None)
899	        self._write(data)
900	        return target

1029	            for member_id in member_ids:
